systems.description: Self-hosted new-api (github.com/QuantumNous/new-api) gateway, deployed on the raspberry-pi-deploy host. Runtime evals bind to it for per-session token minting, billing attribution and usage-log assertions (SG-8.5, SG-9). Values live only in .harnessloop/local/channel-params.json.
Self-owned Raspberry Pi (hostname olegpi, Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS, aarch64) hosting the new-api instance. Reached over SSH for deployment and for reading container/service state during runtime evals.
D3-proxy (app/server) instance run locally during evals. Its own config lives in app/server/.env (gitignored); the values are mirrored in channel-params.json.

An openclaw kernel started in isolation per app/kernel-client/OPENCLAW-ISOLATED-RUN-RECIPE.md — its own state dir, its own gateway port, channels skipped — so an eval never touches the user's ambient openclaw. SG-10's UI shell drives a real round-trip against this instance.

A hermes ACP/api_server instance started in isolation per app/kernel-client/HERMES-ISOLATED-RUN-RECIPE.md (own HERMES_HOME, own port). Used by kernel-conformance evals; note the upstream provider-relabel defect recorded at NousResearch/hermes-agent#63681 requires provider:custom rather than auto in this deployment.
